import numpy as np
from itertools import combinations

def shap_value(model, x, feature_idx, background):
    n = len(x)
    other_features = [i for i in range(n) if i != feature_idx]
    shap = 0
    for s in range(len(other_features) + 1):
        for subset in combinations(other_features, s):
            x_with = x.copy()
            x_without = background.copy()
            for i in subset:
                x_without[i] = x[i]
            x_with_subset = x_without.copy()
            x_with_subset[feature_idx] = x[feature_idx]
            marginal = model(x_with_subset) - model(x_without)
            weight = np.math.factorial(s) * np.math.factorial(n - s - 1) / np.math.factorial(n)
            shap += weight * marginal
    return shap
